BRAF V600E mutations occur in approximately 8 to 12% of metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) cases and define an aggressive phenotype with poor prognosis. While the BEACON CRC trial established encorafenib-based combinations as effective second-line options, direct head-to-head comparisons among available BRAF-targeted regimens are lacking. This network meta-analysis (NMA) compared the relative efficacy and safety of second- and later-line BRAF-targeted regimens in BRAF V600E–mutant mCRC.
